subject: Post-call recap: Redwood integration & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@nimbus.ai>, Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@nimbus.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Ethan Park <ethan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Sep 2026 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: Redwood integration & next steps

Hi Sophie / Alex —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we’re aligned.

Key pain points you shared:
- Search and semantic ranking latency spikes during peak query periods (esp. morning batch).
- Inconsistent relevance from current embedding + BM25 hybrid — re-ranking needed.
- Need for streaming results in UI to improve perceived latency and support partial rendering.
- Desire for structured outputs (JSON) and function-calling style responses so downstream services can consume results without brittle parsing.

Goals we agreed on:
- Sub-250ms median token latency for inference on short prompts (company search flows).
- Improve top-5 relevance via embeddings + reranking evaluation on your 2k eval queries.
- Smooth integration path for web client using our SDK and streaming API.

Product fit highlights we discussed:
- Embeddings + reranker flow: Redwood supports first-pass embedding search and an on-request reranker to prioritize results; we can run both in-pipeline for lower overall cost.
- Streaming & partial output: Redwood streaming APIs let you pipe tokens as they’re generated and include structured output frames for reliable parsing.
- Function calling / structured outputs: Redwood’s structured schema mode returns validated JSON objects (and we can map to your existing response contract).
- SDKs & integration: We have JS/TypeScript and Python SDKs; minimal changes expected, mainly a call to streaming API + structured-output schema.

Proposed next steps:
1) Technical deep dive + demo with Aditya (SE) to walk through streaming, structured outputs, and reranker config. I’ve cc’d him here.
2) Provide sample eval set and schema for structured outputs (Alex, can you share a small sample by EOD Wed?).
3) Short mutual action plan (attached) and a 4-week PoC: 2-week integration + 2-week evaluation.
4) Security/PII checklist — Alex, if you can flag requirements we’ll route to our security team.

Attachments: redwood-integration-overview.pdf (high-level), mutual-action-plan-nimbus.xlsx (draft MAP)

Available times for the deep dive (PST): Wed 9/23 10:00–11:00, Thu 9/24 09:00–10:00 or Fri 9/25 13:00–14:00. Let me know what works and I’ll send a calendar invite.

Thanks — excited to move forward.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0148
https://redwood.com
From: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@nimbus.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@nimbus.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Sep 2026 17:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Redwood integration & next steps

Thanks Marissa — great summary. Confirming a few priorities on our side:
- Security is non-negotiable (SOC2 + data residency for PII) — we’ll need your security questionnaire and any SOC2 report.
- Our main KPI is relevance lift on top-5 results and median query latency under load.
- We can share a representative eval set and current reranker config (Alex will pull).

We’re keen on a PoC but need visibility on pricing for the reranker + streaming consumption. Can you include a rough cost estimate for a 10k queries/day workload?

Wed 9/23 10am PST works for the deep dive. Please send invite and any pre-reads.

—
Sophie Turner
Head of Search & Data Products | Nimbus Analytics

Date: Wed, 23 Sep 2026 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Redwood integration & next steps

Thanks Sophie — invite sent for Wed 9/23 10:00–10:45 PST (Aditya will demo streaming + structured outputs + reranking flow).

Answers to immediate asks:
- Security: attaching the MAP and the high-level integration doc. Aditya, can you share the SOC2 pointer and security questionnaire link during the call?
- Pricing estimate: ballpark for 10k queries/day with a two-stage flow (embedding index + reranker) is in the attached MAP tab labeled “pricing-estimate”. We’ll provide a formalized quote after the PoC scope is agreed.
- PoC access: we can provide a sandbox API key scoped to a private index and a small dedicated pool for predictable latency for the PoC.

Alex — can you share the eval set + a sample expected JSON schema for structured outputs before the call? If it’s too large, a 200-query sample will do. That will help Aditya prepare specific examples.

Next steps summary (short):
- Wed 9/23 10:00 PST: technical deep dive (Aditya leading).
- Alex: share eval set + schema (by EOD Tues 9/22; if not possible, bring a subset to the call).
- Redwood: provide sandbox key + MAP + pricing estimate.

Thanks all — see you on Wednesday.

—
Marissa Cole

Sounds good — I’ll be ready for Wed’s deep dive. A couple quick asks to make the session productive:
- Can Alex drop a small sample of the current result JSON and the schema you want back (fields + types)? I want to validate Redwood’s structured-output mode maps cleanly.
- Also, what is your average input prompt size (tokens / characters) and max expected batch size for reranker calls? That will help me size the dedicated pool for the PoC.

I’ll bring a short demo: streaming partial results, an example reranker config, and a sample SDK integration (TS + Python).
